title: Fix deployment failure by bundling jsPDF/JSZip and improving runtime error handling

requirements.summary: Remove CDN-loaded jsPDF/JSZip globals and bundle them via the frontend build system using module imports.
acceptanceCriteria: The app no longer includes external CDN <script> tags for jsPDF or JSZip in frontend/index.html.
frontend/src/lib/pdf/generateProductPdf.ts no longer reads jsPDF from window.jspdf and instead uses a module import.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildProductZip.ts no longer reads JSZip from window.JSZip and instead uses a module import.
TypeScript builds without needing global Window type declarations for jspdf/JSZip.

file_operations.description: Remove the external CDN <script> tags that load jsPDF and JSZip so the app no longer relies on runtime globals.
Add npm dependencies for jspdf and jszip (and any required type packages) so they are bundled by the frontend build system.
Replace window.jspdf usage with a module import from the bundled jsPDF package and remove global Window type declarations.
Replace window.JSZip usage with a module import from the bundled JSZip package and remove global Window type declarations.
Replace window.JSZip usage with a module import from the bundled JSZip package and remove global Window type declarations to keep bundling consistent across ZIP creation paths.

requirements.summary: Ensure builds succeed after dependency changes and add user-facing, English-only error handling for PDF/ZIP generation failures without crashing the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend production build completes successfully without referencing window.jspdf or window.JSZip.
Product PDF generation still produces a valid multi-page PDF blob.
Product ZIP generation still produces a valid ZIP blob containing the expected files (PDF, cover image, templates/checklists/prompts folders when present, README.md).
If PDF or ZIP generation throws an error, the UI presents an English error message and the app remains usable (no blank screen/crash).

file_operations.description: Add clear error wrapping around PDF generation and ZIP building so callers receive consistent, user-friendly English error messages while preserving the underlying error for logging/debugging.
Improve generation error presentation to use clearer English messaging (distinguish PDF vs ZIP failures when possible) while keeping the app usable and avoiding crashes.
Add guarded error handling for the “Download All Products” flow (master ZIP creation) so failures show an English error message in the UI and do not break the screen.
